reviewers.label: sec
reviewers.focus: Security. Authn/authz on every new or changed endpoint, injection (SQL, command, template), secrets in logs or responses, input validation, rate limiting and resource exhaustion, SSRF, error messages that leak internals. CHANGES only for high or medium findings.

reviewers.label: api
reviewers.focus: API contract. Backwards compatibility of requests, responses and status codes; versioning; error shapes; pagination; OpenAPI kept in sync; clear, actionable error messages. CHANGES for any breaking change without a version bump or deprecation.

reviewers.label: rel
reviewers.focus: Reliability and operations. Timeouts, retries with backoff, idempotency of writes and consumers, transactions, migrations that are safe under load (expand and contract), observability (logs, metrics, traces) for the new path, graceful degradation. CHANGES when a failure mode would lose or duplicate data.

reviewers.label: code
reviewers.focus: Correctness and code quality. Each acceptance criterion is met and a test proves it; bugs (nil/null handling, unchecked errors, races, leaks); read every caller of a changed function; fits project.conventions; no speculative abstractions. Run the tests yourself and add the line `Tests: <command> -> <result>`. CHANGES for any bug or unmet criterion.

escalate_on: a change to authentication, authorization or session handling
a new or changed public endpoint
a change to a queue, topic or event contract
